tools.name: Blocked & muted export
tools.description: Exports your blocked or muted accounts to CSV/JSON so the lists exist outside of X.

tools.name: Bookmarks export
tools.description: Exports your bookmarks to Markdown, CSV and JSON with author, text, date, metrics and media links.
tools.page: https://x.com/i/history  (X moved bookmarks here; the old /i/bookmarks URL also works)

tools.name: Engagement report
tools.description: Ranks your recent posts by likes, reposts, replies and views, and summarises averages, medians and your best posting slot.

tools.name: Fans
tools.description: Lists the accounts that follow you but you do not follow back.

tools.name: Follower quality
tools.description: Scores your followers with bot-like signals (default avatar, no posts, brand-new account, absurd follow ratio) and lists the suspicious ones.

tools.name: Followers diff
tools.description: Compares your followers (or following) list with the previous run and reports who left, who arrived and who renamed.

tools.name: Inactive following
tools.description: Finds the accounts you follow that have not posted in months (or ever). By default it checks only the ones that do not follow you back, one profile request per account.

tools.name: Likes export
tools.description: Exports the posts you liked to Markdown, CSV and JSON.
tools.page: https://x.com/i/history/likes  (X moved likes here; the old /<handle>/likes URL also works)

tools.name: List members export
tools.description: Exports the members (or followers) of any X List and flags which of them you follow.

tools.name: Non-followers
tools.description: Lists the accounts you follow that do not follow you back.

tools.name: Search export
tools.description: Exports the results of an X search (any query, any tab) to CSV, JSON and Markdown.

tools.name: Thread unroll
tools.description: Reconstructs a thread from any post in it and exports it as clean Markdown, plain text and JSON.
